input.quote: ARTICLE XXI EFFECT OF TERMINATION Upon termination of this Agreement: for any reason (a) the rights and licenses granted to Licensee pursuant to this Agreement will automatically terminate, and (b) Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control
input.rationale: The Agreement has no exit or wind-down provision for our benefit. Article XXI's effect-of-termination text runs one way only: our licence ends immediately and we must ship Licensor's materials back within five days, with no obligation on Licensor to provide migration help or to return, export or delete our own data. Articles XX, XXII and XXIII and the General Provisions contain nothing on transition or data, and no "Customer Data"/"Licensee Data" concept exists anywhere in the document. This fails even the fallback (90 days of assistance and export within 30 days), so we insert a short transition clause at the preferred level immediately after Article XXI: six months of assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of our data in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion after that return. We would accept the 90-day/30-day fallback if Licensor resists the six-month period.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance and Licensee data return/deletion clause after Article XXI
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article XXI only requires us to ship Licensor's materials back and is silent on our own data and exit support, so we added a transition clause: up to six months of assistance at Licensor's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion after return. We can fall back to 90 days of assistance with export within 30 days.

ops.text: ARTICLE XXI-A TRANSITION ASSISTANCE AND RETURN OF LICENSEE DATA Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (a) at Licensee's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days, return to Licensee all data submitted by or on behalf of Licensee or generated for Licensee through use of the Licensed Technology ("Licensee Data") in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete all Licensee Data from its systems and certify such deletion in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
